introduction.text1: I am a Software Developer with commercial experience in building and maintaining web applications. My main focus is frontend development with React, Next.js and TypeScript, but my current work also involves backend development, API creation and Salesforce development using Apex and Lightning Web Components.
introduction.text2: Since 2023, I have been working as a self-employed developer through my own business,
introduction.text3: . I primarily work with WavyApp, where I develop customer-facing websites and web applications, as well as internal platforms for property and apartment management. My responsibilities include developing React and Next.js applications, creating APIs and backend functionality with Node.js, and extending Salesforce solutions using Apex and LWC. I have also worked with React Native on mobile applications.
introduction.text4: I also work with Adlife, where I manage and maintain WordPress websites and implement ongoing content, layout and technical improvements.
introduction.text5: Previously, from 2021 to 2023, I worked as a Junior Software Engineer at BCF Software, developing and testing web and mobile applications using technologies including React, Redux, React Native, JavaScript and TypeScript.
